rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA Category 1 (certified by OSMA, an OSMA/ACCME-accredited provider, or AMA direct credit); AOA Category 1 (Ohio Osteopathic Association / AOA); ACGME/AOA residency or fellowship at 1 hour per week; volunteer care for indigent/uninsured (R.C. 4745.04)
rules.new_licensee_rule: CME must be completed after licensure, i.e. it is checked at renewal; first-time applicants do not take the duty-to-report course.
rules.audit_note: Keep records of completion in accordance with rule 4731-10-08.

topics.who: All physicians (MD, DO, DPM): licensee's duty to report misconduct; only the Medical Board's own video course satisfies it
Physicians providing medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) treatment; Category I CME on substance use disorder and addiction, counts toward the total

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. 50 hours per registration period incl. 1 hour on duty to report misconduct (R.C. 4731.224; no exact topic code, listed under ethics/law). Out-of-state and retired licensees who renew must also comply. Renewal date basis not confirmed.
